title: WAGES: Workload-Aware GPU Sharing System for Energy-Efficient Serverless LLM Serving
problem: Serverless LLM serving uses static exclusive GPU allocation causing over-provisioning and low utilization; hardware-controlled clock frequencies waste energy.
motivation: Fine-grained GPU multiplexing and dynamic clock scaling can improve SLO attainment and energy efficiency for serverless LLM serving.
method: WAGES: workload-aware GPU sharing using NVIDIA MPS; dynamically tunes SM partitions and clock speeds; two-tier scheduling framework.
key_novelty: Workload-aware SM partitioning and dynamic clock scaling for serverless LLM; simultaneous SLO improvement and energy reduction.
contributions: Dynamic SM partitioning and clock scaling
